# ZugZug — llms.txt

> Turn your IDE into Warcraft III. Earn gold, level up, build your base, farm achievements, and collect legendary loot — all while shipping code.

ZugZug plays voice lines and shows bold on-screen overlay banners from Warcraft, StarCraft, Portal, Zelda, and 75+ other games when your AI coding agent finishes a task, needs permission, or hits an error. On top of that, it layers a full WC3 metagame: economy, buildings, loot, achievements, combos, and a live dashboard. Works with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, OpenCode, Codex, Kiro, Windsurf, and any MCP-compatible AI agent.

## Links

- Website: https://zugzug-6l4.pages.dev
- GitHub: https://github.com/MikeKovetsky/zugzug.sh
- Pack Browser: https://openpeon.com/packs
- CESP Spec: https://openpeon.com/spec
- Registry: https://github.com/PeonPing/registry

## Install

```bash
brew install MikeKovetsky/zugzug/zugzug && zugzug update
```

Or without Homebrew:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MikeKovetsky/zugzug.sh/main/install.sh | bash
```

## What it does

When your AI agent finishes a task, asks for permission, or hits an error, ZugZug plays a voice line from a game character. The Warcraft orc peon says "Work, work." when a task completes. GLaDOS says "Oh, it's you." when a session starts. Duke Nukem says "Son of a bitch!" when something breaks. Every event also feeds the WC3 metagame: earning gold, gaining XP, leveling up your character, and triggering loot drops.

## MCP Server

ZugZug includes an MCP server so any AI agent can call `play_sound` directly. The agent picks the sound based on context — no hooks required, works with any MCP client (Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, etc).

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "peon-ping": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["/path/to/peon-ping/mcp/peon-mcp.js"]
    }
  }
}
```

MCP tools: `play_sound`
MCP resources: `peon-ping://catalog`, `peon-ping://pack/{name}`

## Hook Events Supported

- session.start — Session or workspace opens
- session.end — Session closes gracefully
- task.acknowledge — Agent accepted work, is processing
- task.complete — Work finished successfully
- task.error — Something failed
- task.progress — Long-running task still in progress
- input.required — Blocked, waiting for user input or approval
- resource.limit — Rate, token, or quota limit hit
- user.spam — User sending commands too fast

## IDEs Supported (hook-based)

- Claude Code (built-in)
- GitHub Copilot (adapter)
- OpenAI Codex
- Cursor
- OpenCode
- Kilo CLI
- Kiro (Amazon)
- Windsurf (Codeium)
- Google Antigravity
- OpenClaw (via adapters/openclaw.sh — call with any CESP category or Claude Code event name)

## Sound Packs (75+ available)

Packs use the OpenPeon (CESP v1.0) standard. Each pack maps event categories to audio files.

Notable packs: peon (Warcraft III orc), glados (Portal), sc_kerrigan (StarCraft), duke_nukem, tf2_engineer, hd2_helldiver (Helldivers 2), ra2_kirov (Red Alert 2), dota2_axe, molag_bal (Elder Scrolls), rick (Rick and Morty), murloc (Warcraft), ocarina_of_time (Zelda).

Full list: https://openpeon.com/packs

## WC3 Metagame

Full Warcraft III base-building metagame layered on coding sessions:

- Character Progression: 15 levels from Peon (Lvl 1) through heroes of every WC3 faction (Orc, Human, Troll, Undead, Pandaren, Night Elf, Tauren). Level determines sound pack, overlay portrait, and dashboard character. Level 15 is a secret.
- Economy: Earn gold (task completions) and lumber (prompts). Gold mine depletion, debt with interest.
- Buildings: 8 structures with real perks (combos, fatigue pause, random events, on-demand taunts).
- Items: 31 items across 5 rarity tiers. Equip for gold/lumber bonuses, fatigue resistance, combo persistence.
- Achievements: 14 WC3-themed milestones tracked across sessions.
- Fatigue: Accumulates with tasks. Burrow pauses it for 1 hour. Resets daily.
- Combos: Multi-kill tracking (Double/Triple/Mega/UNSTOPPABLE/GODLIKE).
- Dashboard: Auto-opens at localhost:19997. Character page, base map, inventory, achievements, stats, activity feed.

## Key Features

- Volume control (0.0–1.0)
- No-repeat logic per category
- Category toggles (enable/disable individual events)
- Desktop notifications (overlay or standard)
- Terminal tab title updates (● project: done)
- Mobile push notifications (ntfy.sh, Pushover, Telegram)
- Remote development support (SSH, devcontainers, Codespaces)
- Level-driven sound packs (level determines which voice you hear)
- Multi-language packs (English, Spanish, French, Czech, Polish, Russian)

## Configuration

Config file: `~/.claude/hooks/peon-ping/config.json`

Key settings: volume, categories (per-event toggles), active_pack, pack_rotation, pack_rotation_mode, desktop_notifications, silent_window_seconds.

## CLI Commands

```bash
peon pause / resume / status
peon volume [0.0-1.0]
peon rotation [random|round-robin|agentskill]
peon packs list / use / install / next / remove
peon notifications on / off / test
peon economy / build / achievements / inventory / equip / unequip / use
peon raid [status|<boss>] / brew [list|<item>]
peon dashboard
peon mobile ntfy <topic>
peon relay --daemon
peon trainer on / off / log / status
```

## Claude Code Skills

Four skills are installed alongside ZugZug for use inside Claude Code sessions:

- `/peon-ping-toggle` — Mute/unmute sounds for the current session
- `/peon-ping-config` — Modify any setting (volume, packs, categories, etc.)
- `/peon-ping-use <pack>` — Assign a specific pack to the current agent session (agentskill mode)
- `/peon-ping-log <n> <exercise>` — Log exercise reps to the Peon Trainer (e.g. `/peon-ping-log 25 pushups`)
